identity.title: Pokémon Horizons: Season 2—The Search for Laqua

leadText:
Pokémon Horizons: Season 2—The Search for Laqua is the second season of the dubbed version of . It is the twenty-seventh season of the Pokémon animated series. The season follows Liko and Roy, now joined by Dot, as they enroll in Naranja Academy to master the art of stallization before continuing their travels around the with a group of adventurers known as the Rising Volt Tacklers in pursuit of understanding more about Lucius, the Six Heroes, and Laqua.

In , episodes were added on Netflix beginning on February 7, 2025 and concluding on September 26, 2025. In , it debuted on January 13, 2025 on BBC iPlayer. In , it debuted on February 8, 2025 on Cartoon Network and YTV. In , it debuted on February 27, 2025 on 9Go!. In Asia, it debuted on February 28, 2025 on the Pokémon Asia ENG YouTube channel. In sub-Saharan Africa, it debuted on April 26, 2025 on Cartoon Network Africa.

It is preceded by , and succeeded by Pokémon Horizons: Season 3—Rising Hope. It comprises the Terastal Debut and Rayquaza Rising arcs from the Japanese version.

In , episodes were added on Netflix beginning on February 7, 2025 and concluding on September 26, 2025. In , it debuted on January 13, 2025 on BBC iPlayer. In , it debuted on February 8, 2025 on Cartoon Network and YTV. In , it debuted on February 27, 2025 on 9Go!. In Asia, it debuted on February 28, 2025 on the Pokémon Asia ENG YouTube channel. In sub-Saharan Africa, it debuted on April 26, 2025 on Cartoon Network Africa.

It is preceded by , and succeeded by Pokémon Horizons: Season 3—Rising Hope. It comprises the Terastal Debut and Rayquaza Rising arcs from the Japanese version.

==Blurb==
 The adventure continues for Liko and Roy as they travel the world in search of the remaining Six Hero Pokémon and the legendary land of Laqua. But to grow as Pokémon Trainers, a new challenge awaits — Tera Training! Journeying through Paldea, Liko, Roy and Dot must hone their Terastallization skills and battle the region’s powerful Gym Leaders. Then, Liko, Roy and the rest of the Rising Volt Tacklers resume their pursuit of the Six Heroes, including the black Rayquaza, as both they and the Explorers race to uncover the secrets behind Terapagos and finally find the path that will lead them to Laqua.

==Trivia==
 
This is the first season:
in the English dub to include "Season" in its name, in contrast to the previous seasons.
where an opening theme for the English dub contains a majority of the lyrics in another language, as Will -Korean ver.-, the opening theme for the Asian release of the English dub, has lyrics in Korean.
where the English dub uses different ending themes for different releases of the same episodes depending on the country, with an instrumental version of My Favorite Pokémon for the international release and Make You Shine (English Ver.) for the Asian release.
to air on YTV in regularly after 10 years, since Corus Entertainment moved the series to Teletoon during the run of .
In Asian territories where The Pokémon Company holds distribution rights, this season is also numbered as season 27 of the Pokémon animated series as a whole. However the logo used in the listings and during the episodes remains unchanged.
It is listed as "Season 27" also on 9Now in , where it uses a modified logo with the "Season 2" text removed , despite the previous season having been listed as "Season 1" and the logo sequence in the episodes itself being unchanged. On other streaming services in Australia, such as Stan, the logo remains unmodified.

In Asian territories where The Pokémon Company holds distribution rights, this season is also numbered as season 27 of the Pokémon animated series as a whole. However the logo used in the listings and during the episodes remains unchanged.

aiReadySummary.title: Pokémon Horizons: Season 2—The Search for Laqua
aiReadySummary.searchableText:
Pokémon Horizons: Season 2—The Search for Laqua
Category:Pokémon Horizons: The Series episodes
Pokémon Horizons: Season 2—The Search for Laqua is the second season of the dubbed version of . It is the twenty-seventh season of the Pokémon animated series. The season follows Liko and Roy, now joined by Dot, as they enroll in Naranja Academy to master the art of stallization before continuing their travels around the with a group of adventurers known as the Rising Volt Tacklers in pursuit of understanding more about Lucius, the Six Heroes, and Laqua.

In , episodes were added on Netflix beginning on February 7, 2025 and concluding on September 26, 2025. In , it debuted on January 13, 2025 on BBC iPlayer. In , it debuted on February 8, 2025 on Cartoon Network and YTV. In , it debuted on February 27, 2025 on 9Go!. In Asia, it debuted on February 28, 2025 on the Pokémon Asia ENG YouTube channel. In sub-Saharan Africa, it debuted on April 26, 2025 on Cartoon Network Africa.

It is preceded by , and succeeded by Pokémon Horizons: Season 3—Rising Hope. It comprises the Terastal Debut and Rayquaza Rising arcs from the Japanese version.
